QUOTE: Files outside the Doxygen pattern list are picked up by the parse-built front end when `synth.claims()` accepts them (JS/TS and the script types). Everything else is ignored.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the resolved scope is filtered by Doxygen's file patterns, and it names the parse-built front end as the path for file types Doxygen can't read.
